Order: construct, setParam(all defaults), setParam(overrides), reset(), then process the blocks in `blockSizes` back to back over ONE buffer. NOTE: FxChain.process advances every Smoother once in gate() AND once per sample, so smoothers step count+1 times per block. That is the reference behaviour and the port must reproduce it, block sizes included.
